source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Wear a surgical mask and perform hand hygiene; a gown and gloves are unnecessary.","B":"Wear eye protection and perform hand hygiene; a gown and gloves are unnecessary.","C":"Wear a gown and gloves for contact with the client or the client's environment.","D":"Use hand hygiene alone because Contact Precautions do not add PPE to Standard Precautions."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC Contact Precautions call for gown and gloves for interactions involving the patient or patient environment. Additional PPE may be required under Standard Precautions for specific tasks. Option C is correct; the other choices omit the core contact barriers.
source_row.source_detail: Contact Precautions: use gown and gloves for interactions that may involve contact with the patient or the patient's environment, in addition to Standard Precautions and task-specific PPE. CDC Transmission-Based Precautions page current; live-rechecked 2026-08-15. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Safe and Effective Care Environment — Safety and Infection Prevention and Control: transmission precautions, PPE, device/environmental safety, asepsis, identification and infection-prevention activities as applicable. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
source_row.stem: A client is on Contact Precautions. Which PPE is required for interactions that may involve contact with the client or environment?
